### ⚡ Available ECC Agent Skills & Commands

- **/stock `<ticker>`**: Fetch live real-time price & trading volume.
- **/metrics `<ticker>`**: Inspect P/E ratio, market cap, and profit margins.
- **/portfolio**: View your tracked portfolio holdings and average cost basis.
- **/audit**: Run a portfolio concentration, risk, and compliance audit.
- **/plan `<goal>`**: Formulate a structured step-by-step financial plan.
- **/clear**: Reset the session history and active ticker memory.
